title: Space Age Wine Packaging
summary: This project redesigns the label for Space Age Rosé by Grounded Wine Co., reinterpreting the brand through a more expressive and concept driven visual system.

overview.challenge: The original packaging was harder to understand conceptually and looked too serious.
overview.solution: The redesign shifts the focus toward exploration and possibility.
overview.outcome: The finished label system pairs a hand-drawn astronaut with a vineyard reflected in the visor, giving the rosé packaging a cohesive, exploratory character across the bottle, back label, and capsule.

hero.alt: Space Age Rosé label redesign mockup.

blocks.label: 01 — Sketches
blocks.heading: A wine label with a sense of exploration
blocks.body: Early concepts explored space-age imagery and how it could connect to the wine’s identity. The astronaut illustration became the central device, with the vineyard reflected in the visor to link the cosmic theme back to the place and product.
